# API reference

Generated from the source of `github.com/otfabric/go-knx` with `docsync api`; the doc comments are the documentation. The guides around it explain how the pieces fit.

| Package | Synopsis |
|---|---|
| [github.com/otfabric/go-knx](go-knx.md) | Package knx holds the types shared by every part of go-knx: individual and group addresses, telegram priorities, the sentinel errors, the logging and metrics interfaces and the connection state. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-knx/apdu](apdu.md) | Package apdu decodes and encodes the transport layer control information (TPCI) and the application layer protocol data unit (APCI and data) carried in the TPDU of an L_Data frame. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-knx/cemi](cemi.md) | Package cemi encodes and decodes frames of the common External Message Interface (cEMI): the data link layer messages (L_Data, L_Busmon, L_Raw) that KNXnet/IP tunnelling and routing carry, and the local device management messages (M_PropRead, M_PropWrite, M_Reset, function properties) of KNXnet/IP device management. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-knx/client](client.md) | Package client is KNX group communication over a link: a KNXnet/IP tunnel (package tunnel) or routing (package routing). |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-knx/datasecure](datasecure.md) | Package datasecure implements KNX Data Secure for group communication: the S-A_Data service that authenticates, and optionally encrypts, the APDU of a telegram end to end with a group key and a 48-bit sequence number per sender. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-knx/device](device.md) | Package device models virtual KNX devices: an individual address and group objects (communication objects) with their datapoint type, group addresses, communication flags and current value. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-knx/devmgmt](devmgmt.md) | Package devmgmt is a KNXnet/IP device management client: it reads and writes the interface object properties of a KNXnet/IP server (local device management with M_PropRead and M_PropWrite) over a device management connection. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-knx/discovery](discovery.md) | Package discovery finds KNXnet/IP servers (SEARCH_REQUEST, multicast or directed unicast, standard or extended) and reads their self description (DESCRIPTION_REQUEST). |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-knx/dpt](dpt.md) | Package dpt encodes and decodes KNX datapoint types (DPT): the standardised representations of application values in group telegrams. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-knx/keyring](keyring.md) | Package keyring reads and writes KNX keyring files (.knxkeys, namespace http://knx.org/xml/keyring/1), the export of the secure keys and passwords of an ETS project: the backbone key of secure routing, the users and passwords of secure tunnelling, the group keys and senders of Data Secure, and the device keys. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-knx/knxnetip](knxnetip.md) | Package knxnetip encodes and decodes KNXnet/IP frames: the header, host protocol address information (HPAI), description information blocks (DIB), connection request and response information (CRI, CRD) and the bodies of the core, device management, tunnelling, routing and secure services. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-knx/mgmt](mgmt.md) | Package mgmt implements remote device management over the KNX network: the application layer services a tool sends to a device's individual address (A_PropertyValue_Read, _Write and _Response, A_PropertyDescription_Read and _Response, A_DeviceDescriptor_Read and _Response), connectionless or in a transport layer connection, optionally secured with the device's tool key (KNX Data Secure point to point, S-A_Data with tool access). |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-knx/routing](routing.md) | Package routing sends and receives KNX telegrams with KNXnet/IP routing: ROUTING_INDICATIONs on an IP multicast group (224.0.23.12:3671 by default), with flow control. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-knx/secure](secure.md) | Package secure implements KNX IP Secure (KNXnet/IP Secure): the key derivations, the session handshake of secure tunnelling, the SECURE_WRAPPER encryption, and the timer of secure routing. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-knx/server](server.md) | Package server is a KNXnet/IP server: it answers discovery (search, extended search) and description requests, accepts tunnelling connections from KNXnet/IP clients, and optionally routes over IP multicast. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-knx/tunnel](tunnel.md) | Package tunnel is a KNXnet/IP tunnelling client over UDP: it connects to a KNXnet/IP server (an IP interface or router), sends cEMI frames with acknowledgement and retransmission, receives telegrams with sequence checking and duplicate suppression, keeps the connection alive with heartbeats and, optionally, reconnects. |
